captions.linkedin:
We tested 12,621 Australian small-business websites with Google Lighthouse on a simulated mid-range phone.

Median time to show the main content: Squarespace 11.1 s, Shopify 11.1 s, WordPress 7.4 s, Wix 6.6 s. Google's 'good' bar is 2.5 s.

47.2% of Squarespace sites scored 'poor'.

Full method: prycedigital.com/research
